## 1. Load the processed data
```{r}
#install packages
library("psych")

#load data: I change my r project directory to processed_data folder, given that I changed to use my computer instead of the renting one.
h1Data <- read.csv("h1Data.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv("h2Data.csv")
```

## 2. Check Distribution

```{r histogram}
h1Data$Gender_new <- factor(h1Data$Gender_new,
                           levels = c("Male_Intersex", "Female"))

table(h1Data$Gender_new, useNA = "ifany")

hist(h1Data$Love_how_much_1,
     main = "Distribution of love intensity",
     xlab = "Love intensity (0–100)")

hist(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1,
     main = "Distribution of willingness to marry without love",
     xlab = "Willingness to marry without love (0–100)")

hist(h2Data$satisfaction,
     main = "Distribution of relationship satisfaction",
     xlab = "Relationship satisfaction (1–7)")

```

## 3. Check mean and IQR and ranges

```{r individual_stats}
#intense of love
mean(h1Data$Love_how_much_1, na.rm = TRUE)
median(h1Data$Love_how_much_1, na.rm = TRUE)
range(h1Data$Love_how_much_1, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR(h1Data$Love_how_much_1, na.rm = TRUE)

#marry without love
mean(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, na.rm = TRUE)
median(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, na.rm = TRUE)
range(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, na.rm = TRUE)

#relationship satisfaction
mean(h2Data$satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE)
median(h2Data$satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE)
table(h2Data$satisfaction, useNA = "ifany")
range(h2Data$satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR(h2Data$satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE)


```

## 4. Standardize a variable

```{r standardize}
h2Data$satisfaction_z <- as.numeric(scale(h2Data$satisfaction))

mean(h2Data$satisfaction_z, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(h2Data$satisfaction_z, na.rm = TRUE)

```

## 5. Covariance and correlation

```{r association}
cov(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, h2Data$satisfaction,
    use = "complete.obs")

cor(h2Data$Love_would_you_marry_1, h2Data$satisfaction,
    use = "complete.obs")

corData <- h2Data[, c("Love_would_you_marry_1", "satisfaction")]

cor(corData, use = "complete.obs")
```


## 6. Several statistics at once

```{r combined summaries}
summary(h1Data$Love_how_much_1)

psych::describe(h1Data$Love_how_much_1)

psych::describeBy(h1Data$Love_how_much_1,
                  group = h1Data$Gender_new)

summary(corData)

psych::describe(corData)
```
